exposure: Diminished ovarian reserve (defined as antral follicle count ≤ 6)
No diminished ovarian reserve (defined as antral follicle count > 6)
outcome: Placental findings (anatomic, inflammatory, vascular malperfusion, villous maturation lesions)
cohort: The study included live singleton births after IVF between 2009 and 2017.
finding: Diminished ovarian reserve (DOR) is associated with a significantly higher rate of preeclampsia and multiple placental fetal vascular malperfusion lesions.
